boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Howard University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations around Howard University with late availability documented on current official business pages.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 1412 U Street NW
cards.title: Tacos Until 4 a.m.
cards.subtitle: U Street Corridor southeast of Howard
cards.notes: Check the live location page before leaving, then walk southeast toward U Street or arrange a pickup for the return trip.
cards.short_summary: A nearby fast-food counter with documented service deep into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page identifies 1412 U Street NW and lists dine-in service until 4:00 a.m. on Sunday.
cards.source_title: Fast Food Near Me in Washington, DC - 1412 U Street NW | Taco Bell
cards.access_notes: The official page currently shows Sunday dine-in hours of 9:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m.; confirm the selected day before departing.

cards.title: A U Street Pizza Window Before Dawn
cards.subtitle: 1778 U Street NW, west of Howard University
cards.notes: Use the posted U Street address, confirm that night's closing time, and favor pickup or delivery when returning very late.
cards.short_summary: A pizza destination whose own site documents hours extending to 4 or 5 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Duccini’s official site lists its 1778 U Street NW location as open until 4:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 5:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Adams Morgan – Washington, DC - Duccinis Pizza
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 11:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11:00 a.m.–5:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Pizza Corner After Midnight
cards.subtitle: 1501 U Street NW, along the U Street Corridor
cards.notes: Head for the named U Street storefront and verify the weekday schedule first; Friday and Saturday service runs one hour later.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward pizza stop with nightly hours past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Corner’s official contact page lists 1501 U Street NW and business hours until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 11:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Late Carryout on U Street
cards.subtitle: 1511 U Street NW, southeast of Howard
cards.notes: Choose carryout rather than delivery for the latest posted window, and recheck the day-specific schedule before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A U Street pizza shop with separate late delivery and takeout schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s ordering site lists takeout at 1511 U Street NW until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 2:00 a.m. Thursday, and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Takeout closes at 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 2:00 a.m. Thursday, and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; delivery ends earlier.

cards.title: A Fast U Street Pie
cards.subtitle: 1408 U Street NW, near the Howard Theatre side of campus
cards.notes: Use the official U Street listing to locate the storefront between Trader Joe’s and Busboys and Poets, then confirm closing time.
cards.short_summary: A named U Street pizzeria documented by the business as a late-night option.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 90 Second Pizza site lists its U Street shop at 1408 U Street NW and presents the business for late-night pizza service.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists the U Street storefront and late-night service; consult its current location display before leaving for exact nightly closing.

cards.title: Chinese Takeout Past 2 a.m.
cards.subtitle: 1413 14th Street NW, south of Howard University
cards.notes: Check the day before ordering: the kitchen runs latest on Friday and Saturday, while Sunday closes substantially earlier.
cards.short_summary: A late Chinese-food counter with hours published directly by the restaurant.
cards.evidence_claim: Yum’s II lists its address as 1413 14th Street NW and closes at 2:30 a.m. Monday–Thursday and 3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 11:00 a.m.–2:30 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 11:00 a.m.–3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and noon–10:00 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: A Columbia Heights Late Meal
cards.subtitle: 3521 14th Street NW, north of Howard University
cards.notes: Plan this as a northbound trip rather than a quick campus walk, and verify the posted schedule before traveling after midnight.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant north of campus with service until 2 or 3 a.m. every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Buho’s official site lists 3521 14th Street NW and hours until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Kabobs and Pizza After Midnight
cards.subtitle: 2455 18th Street NW in Adams Morgan
cards.notes: Treat this as a longer westbound run from campus; confirm the current schedule and consider delivery when it is already late.
cards.short_summary: A Mediterranean counter with its kitchen documented as open well past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: DC Pizza & Kabobs’ official site lists 2455 18th Street NW and closing times of 2:30 or 3:30 a.m., depending on the night.
cards.source_title: DC Pizza & Kabobs | Mediterranean Restaurant in Washington, DC
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 10:30 a.m.–2:30 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and Saturday, and 10:30 a.m.–3:30 a.m. Thursday–Friday.

cards.title: A 24-Hour Weekend Breakfast Run
cards.subtitle: 3100 14th Street NW in Columbia Heights
cards.notes: Save this for Friday or Saturday if you need true overnight availability; the same location closes at 9 p.m. on several weekdays.
cards.short_summary: An all-night weekend diner option north of Howard University.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official location page lists 3100 14th Street NW as open 24 hours on Friday and Saturday and identifies it as offering dine-in and late-night food.
cards.source_title: IHOP Takeout - Breakfast & Food To-Go at 3100 14th St NW
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours Friday and Saturday only; the official page shows earlier closing on other days, so verify the calendar before traveling.

cards.entity_name: McDonald's at 2228 New York Avenue NE
cards.title: The All-Night Fast-Food Fallback
cards.subtitle: New York Avenue NE, a vehicle or delivery trip from Howard
cards.notes: Reserve this farther destination for a vehicle or delivery run, and use the official locator to check live service status first.
cards.short_summary: A documented 24-hour restaurant and lobby when closer counters have closed.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official location page identifies 2228 New York Avenue NE and lists restaurant, lobby, and drive-through service as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Washington, DC at 2228 New York Ave NE | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: The official locator lists restaurant and lobby hours as 24 hours Monday–Sunday; this destination is not an immediate campus-area walk.
